record.context_brief: Hyperbolic actions generated by central symmetries
record.original_question: In Lobachevsky space of sufficiently large dimension, does there exist a discrete cocompact isometric action generated entirely by central symmetries?

evidence.quote: Consider the Lobachevsky space of sufficiently large dimension. Does it admit a discrete cocompact isometric action generated by (b) central symmetries?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathbb{H}^n$ denote the $n$-dimensional Lobachevsky (real hyperbolic) space, and let $\mathrm{Isom}(\mathbb{H}^n)$ be its full isometry group. For a point $p\in\mathbb{H}^n$, the central symmetry (point reflection) at $p$ is the unique isometry $\sigma_p\in\mathrm{Isom}(\mathbb{H}^n)$ that fixes $p$ and acts as $-\mathrm{id}$ on the tangent space $T_p\mathbb{H}^n$ (equivalently, $\sigma_p$ sends each geodesic through $p$ to itself reversing its direction).

A subgroup $\Gamma\le\mathrm{Isom}(\mathbb{H}^n)$ is said to act discretely and cocompactly on $\mathbb{H}^n$ if $\Gamma$ is a discrete subgroup of $\mathrm{Isom}(\mathbb{H}^n)$ and the quotient $\mathbb{H}^n/\Gamma$ is compact. The subgroup $\Gamma$ is said to be generated by central symmetries if there exists a set $S\subseteq\mathbb{H}^n$ of points such that $\Gamma=\langle\sigma_p:p\in S\rangle$.

Question: Does there exist an integer $n_0$ such that for every $n\ge n_0$ there is a discrete cocompact subgroup $\Gamma\le\mathrm{Isom}(\mathbb{H}^n)$ that is generated by central symmetries?
artifact.status_search_result: No published resolution was found for the existence of a discrete cocompact subgroup of $\mathrm{Isom}(\mathbb{H}^n)$ generated by central symmetries (point reflections) in sufficiently high dimension. The closely related theory of cocompact reflection (mirror) groups is well developed and known to terminate in high dimension (no cocompact reflection groups in $\mathbb{H}^n$ for $n\ge 30$), but the analogous question for groups generated by point reflections appears not to have been settled in the literature accessible by web search.

status_evidence.title: Arithmetic Hyperbolic Reflection Groups (Bogachev)
status_evidence.snippet: There are no cocompact reflection groups in H^n for n >= 30; theory deals with mirror reflections, not central symmetries.
status_evidence.claim: Closely related cocompact reflection-group problem has known dimension bounds, but no analogue is reported for central symmetries.

status_evidence.title: Point reflection (Central symmetry) - Wikipedia
status_evidence.snippet: Central symmetry/point reflection is an isometry; in even dimension it is orientation-preserving, in odd dimension it is not.
status_evidence.claim: Definition of central symmetry as a point reflection isometry.
